name: Liberty Science Center Open 2010

venue.name: [Liberty Science Center](http://www.lsc.org/)
venue.address: 222 Jersey City Blvd, Jersey City, New Jersey 07305

information: The registration fee for pre-registered competitors is $5. If you do not pre-register, the registration fee will be $10. If you do not pre-register, you will not be on the guest list and will have to pay to get into the science center in addition to the registration fee. If you would like to explore the venue, you must purchase admission to the science center.
